affiliations_period_check.name: affiliations_period_check
affiliations_period_check.value: "affiliations"."valid_to" is null or "affiliations"."valid_from" is null or "affiliations"."valid_to" > "affiliations"."valid_from"

artifact_assets_type_matches_content_che.name: artifact_assets_type_matches_content_check
artifact_assets_type_matches_content_che.value: ("artifact_assets"."asset_type" = 'FILE' and "artifact_assets"."file_object_id" is not null) or ("artifact_assets"."asset_type" = 'EXTERNAL_URL' and "artifact_assets"."external_url" is not null)

artifact_reviews_score_check.name: artifact_reviews_score_check
artifact_reviews_score_check.value: "artifact_reviews"."score" is null or ("artifact_reviews"."score" between 1 and 10) or ("artifact_reviews"."score" = 0 and "artifact_reviews"."legacy_zero_score")

artifact_reviews_final_fields_check.name: artifact_reviews_final_fields_check
artifact_reviews_final_fields_check.value: "artifact_reviews"."status" <> 'FINAL' or ("artifact_reviews"."score" is not null and "artifact_reviews"."decision" is not null and "artifact_reviews"."reviewed_at" is not null)

campaign_recipients_sent_check.name: campaign_recipients_sent_check
campaign_recipients_sent_check.value: "campaign_recipients"."status" NOT IN ('SENT', 'DELIVERED') OR "campaign_recipients"."sent_at" IS NOT NULL

cohorts_period_check.name: cohorts_period_check
cohorts_period_check.value: "cohorts"."ends_at" is null or "cohorts"."starts_at" is null or "cohorts"."ends_at" > "cohorts"."starts_at"

contact_points_telegram_stable_id_uidx.name: contact_points_telegram_stable_id_uidx
contact_points_telegram_stable_id_uidx.where: "contact_points"."type" = 'TELEGRAM' and "contact_points"."messenger_stable_id" is not null and "contact_points"."archived_at" is null

contact_points_period_check.name: contact_points_period_check
contact_points_period_check.value: "contact_points"."valid_to" is null or "contact_points"."valid_from" is null or "contact_points"."valid_to" > "contact_points"."valid_from"

event_participations_result_check.name: event_participations_result_check
event_participations_result_check.value: "event_participations"."result" is null or ("event_participations"."result" = btrim("event_participations"."result") and char_length("event_participations"."result") between 1 and 10000)

event_project_participations_result_chec.name: event_project_participations_result_check
event_project_participations_result_chec.value: "event_project_participations"."result" is null or ("event_project_participations"."result" = btrim("event_project_participations"."result") and char_length("event_project_participations"."result") between 1 and 10000)

events_period_check.name: events_period_check
events_period_check.value: "events"."ends_at" is null or "events"."starts_at" is null or "events"."ends_at" > "events"."starts_at"

file_objects_external_storage_check.name: file_objects_external_storage_check
file_objects_external_storage_check.value: ("file_objects"."storage_provider" = 'CRM' and "file_objects"."external_id" is null) or ("file_objects"."storage_provider" = 'LOCKER' and "file_objects"."external_id" is not null)

import_runs_period_check.name: import_runs_period_check
import_runs_period_check.value: "import_runs"."finished_at" is null or "import_runs"."started_at" is null or "import_runs"."finished_at" >= "import_runs"."started_at"

locker_pending_submissions_resolution_ch.name: locker_pending_submissions_resolution_check
locker_pending_submissions_resolution_ch.value:
("locker_pending_submissions"."status" = 'PENDING' AND "locker_pending_submissions"."resolved_at" IS NULL AND "locker_pending_submissions"."resolved_person_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("locker_pending_submissions"."status" = 'REJECTED' AND "locker_pending_submissions"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("locker_pending_submissions"."status" = 'RESOLVED' AND "locker_pending_submissions"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "locker_pending_submissions"."resolved_person_id" IS NOT NULL)

merge_operations_revert_fields_check.name: merge_operations_revert_fields_check
merge_operations_revert_fields_check.value: "merge_operations"."status" = 'APPLIED' or ("merge_operations"."reverted_at" is not null and "merge_operations"."reverted_by_user_id" is not null and "merge_operations"."revert_reason" is not null)

partner_agreements_period_check.name: partner_agreements_period_check
partner_agreements_period_check.value: "partner_agreements"."ends_at" is null or "partner_agreements"."starts_at" is null or "partner_agreements"."ends_at" > "partner_agreements"."starts_at"

person_aliases_period_check.name: person_aliases_period_check
person_aliases_period_check.value: "person_aliases"."valid_to" is null or "person_aliases"."valid_from" is null or "person_aliases"."valid_to" > "person_aliases"."valid_from"

persons_active_russian_fio_check.name: persons_active_russian_fio_check
persons_active_russian_fio_check.value:
"persons"."archived_at" is not null or "persons"."merged_into_person_id" is not null or (
        "persons"."profile_needs_review"
        and "persons"."canonical_full_name" = btrim("persons"."canonical_full_name")
        and char_length("persons"."canonical_full_name") between 1 and 500
      ) or (
        "persons"."last_name" ~ '^[А-Яа-яЁё]+(-[А-Яа-яЁё]+)*$'
        and "persons"."first_name" ~ '^[А-Яа-яЁё]+(-[А-Яа-яЁё]+)*$'
        and "persons"."patronymic" ~ '^[А-Яа-яЁё]+(-[А-Яа-яЁё]+)*$'
        and "persons"."canonical_full_name" = "persons"."last_name" || ' ' || "persons"."first_name" || ' ' || "persons"."patronymic"
      )

persons_profile_review_reason_check.name: persons_profile_review_reason_check
persons_profile_review_reason_check.value:
not "persons"."profile_needs_review" or (
        "persons"."profile_review_reason" is not null
        and "persons"."profile_review_reason" = btrim("persons"."profile_review_reason")
        and char_length("persons"."profile_review_reason") between 1 and 1000
      )

persons_notes_valid_check.name: persons_notes_valid_check
persons_notes_valid_check.value:
"persons"."archived_at" is not null or "persons"."merged_into_person_id" is not null or "persons"."notes" is null or (
        "persons"."notes" = btrim("persons"."notes")
        and char_length("persons"."notes") between 1 and 10000
      )

products_closed_fields_check.name: products_closed_fields_check
products_closed_fields_check.value: "products"."status" <> 'CLOSED' or ("products"."closed_at" is not null and "products"."close_reason" is not null)

programs_period_check.name: programs_period_check
programs_period_check.value: "programs"."ends_at" is null or "programs"."starts_at" is null or "programs"."ends_at" > "programs"."starts_at"

project_applications_payload_check.name: project_applications_payload_check
project_applications_payload_check.value: ("project_applications"."application_type" = 'CREATE' and "project_applications"."project_id" is null and "project_applications"."proposed_name" is not null and "project_applications"."proposed_name" = btrim("project_applications"."proposed_name") and char_length("project_applications"."proposed_name") between 1 and 500) or ("project_applications"."application_type" = 'JOIN' and "project_applications"."project_id" is not null and "project_applications"."proposed_name" is null)

project_applications_text_check.name: project_applications_text_check
project_applications_text_check.value: ("project_applications"."requested_role" = btrim("project_applications"."requested_role") and char_length("project_applications"."requested_role") between 1 and 500) and ("project_applications"."proposed_description" is null or ("project_applications"."proposed_description" = btrim("project_applications"."proposed_description") and char_length("project_applications"."proposed_description") between 1 and 10000)) and ("project_applications"."message" is null or ("project_applications"."message" = btrim("project_applications"."message") and char_length("project_applications"."message") between 1 and 5000)) and ("project_applications"."review_comment" is null or ("project_applications"."review_comment" = btrim("project_applications"."review_comment") and char_length("project_applications"."review_comment") between 1 and 5000))

project_team_links_period_check.name: project_team_links_period_check
project_team_links_period_check.value: "project_team_links"."valid_to" is null or "project_team_links"."valid_from" is null or "project_team_links"."valid_to" > "project_team_links"."valid_from"

projects_period_check.name: projects_period_check
projects_period_check.value: "projects"."ends_at" is null or "projects"."starts_at" is null or "projects"."ends_at" > "projects"."starts_at"

tasks_one_open_next_step_per_person_uidx.name: tasks_one_open_next_step_per_person_uidx
tasks_one_open_next_step_per_person_uidx.where: "tasks"."person_id" is not null and "tasks"."is_next_step" and "tasks"."status" <> 'DONE' and "tasks"."status" <> 'CANCELLED' and "tasks"."archived_at" is null

tasks_subject_check.name: tasks_subject_check
tasks_subject_check.value: "tasks"."person_id" is not null or "tasks"."project_id" is not null

team_memberships_period_check.name: team_memberships_period_check
team_memberships_period_check.value: "team_memberships"."valid_to" is null or "team_memberships"."valid_from" is null or "team_memberships"."valid_to" > "team_memberships"."valid_from"
